caption: A brush loaded with red paint is swirled through a jar of clean water, and the water turns pink and cloudy.

sa.check: A jar of clean water is present.
A brush loaded with red paint is swirled through it.
The water turns pink and cloudy.
The swirl comes first and the pink follows.

pc.expect: The pink spreads from the brush through the water streaming off the brush and getting more even with each swirl and never gathers back; coloured areas stay coloured.
pc.fail: The water returns to its original colour where it was pink; or the pink gathers back into the brush; or the pink appears before the brush arrives.

pc.expect: The result is pink, and un-reached water keeps its original colour.
pc.fail: The water turns a colour other than pink; or the un-reached water changes; or the pink is darker than the brush itself.

pc.expect: The water behaves as it should: streaks and swirls where stirred or spread, settling where it flows.
pc.fail: The water is rigid and unmarked; or it flows like water when it is a paste; or it bounces like rubber.

pc.expect: The water moves only where stirred or where the pink flows.
pc.fail: The water swirls by itself; or the pink spreads faster than stirring or flow carries it; or the container moves.

pc.expect: The amount of water stays the same and the container keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The container fills or empties on its own; or a second container appears; or the brush passes through the container.

pc.expect: The container and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The container changes colour; or the background rearranges; or the tool changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
